notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Clans
notes.content:
Clans is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off to celebrate!

Your goal is to confront and destroy the Demon and locate the lost Crown of Peace. You will roam your once-beautiful land, routing out the Demon's hateful minions, solving the mysteries of the fortress, and moving ever closer to your final encounter with the Demon. Summon your courage and raise your sword for a fight to the death.
